newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - July 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - July 4.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

High Court Judges say concerned over a President's Counsel garlanding an editor immediately after he was convicted of a criminal charge. President's Counsel Desmond Fernando garlanded Sunday Times newspaper editor Sinha Ratnatunga in courts, soon after the latter was found guilty of criminally defaming President Chandrika Kumaratunga earlier this week.
High Court Judgs Association condemn garlanding of convicted nespaper editor Sinha Ratnatunga by a President's Counsel Desmond Fernando.
Bishop of Jaffna calls for third party mediation to find lasting solution to Sri Lanka's northeast conflict.

Population of northern Jaffna peninsula rises to 450,000, government officials in the area said. They expect the population to rise by further 200,000 by year end, as many who fled fighting between Tamnil separatists and the the security force are now returning. Jaffna was captured by the army last year.
Government gives final touches to code of conduct for state-owned media institutions.
